name: Naga Chaitanya Akkineni
bio: Naga Chaitanya Akkineni is an Indian film actor who works in Telugu cinema. He debuted in the 2009 film Josh, directed by newcomer Vasu Varma and produced by Dil Raju. Subsequently, in 2017, he starred in Rarandoi Veduka Chudham, which became his career's highest grosser till date.

credits.title: Vrushakarma
credits.overview: In a desperate quest to decode ancient cave carvings, a treasure hunter hungry for untold riches, an obsessed archaeologist, and a devoted history student race against time to unravel a prophecy tied to royal lineage and the impending apocalypse, confronting the forces of destiny and evil along the way.

credits.title: Thandel
credits.overview: Fisherman Raju is deeply in love with Satya. However, at one point, she urges him to stop going to the sea and look for other jobs. Ignoring her plea, Raju ventures out and accidentally drifts into Pakistani waters, where he is arrested.

credits.title: Custody
credits.overview: Siva, a police officer, has to escort a witness to the court. He learns that all the police service wants to kill the witness. An escape begins.

credits.title: Laal Singh Chaddha
credits.overview: Events in India's history — from the Emergency and the famous Cricket World Cup win to the Punjab riots ,  unfold from the perspective of an innocent Sikh man Laal Singh Chaddha, a person with a low IQ but high optimism. Laal is able to achieve everything under the sun but his childhood love continues to elude him.

credits.title: Thank You
credits.overview: Abhiram aka Abhi is a successful entrepreneur who calls himself ‘self-made’ and doesn’t believe anyone but himself is the reason for his success. But when he’s forced to look back on life, what does he realise?

credits.title: Bangarraju
credits.overview: Chinna Bangarraju is taking forward his grandfather Bangarraju's legacy of being a massive flirt. His worried grandmother however wants to ensure he's not lonely anymore before she passes on.

credits.title: Love Story
credits.overview: Revanth and Mouni dream big when it comes to their lives. But with their social standing and gender proved to be a hindrance, will they manage to find a way to let their love prevail?

credits.title: Venky Mama
credits.overview: When his sister and her husband die in a car accident, a rice-mill owner decides to raise his nephew as his own child. They become inseparable over the course of time, but there are evil forces at work that are trying to separate them.

credits.title: Oh! Baby
credits.overview: A 70-year-old woman transforms into her 24-year-old self after she's photographed at a studio, changing her life and those of the people around her forever.

credits.title: Majili
credits.overview: Poorna fails to appreciate the blessings in his life due to his unfulfilled dream of a cricket career and a failed romance that changes him.

credits.title: Savyasachi
credits.overview: A twin brother of the protagonist is absorbed due to Vanishing Twin Syndrome and controls his left hand. When his life is threatened, the twin brother that never existed protects him like a shield.

credits.title: Shailaja Reddy Alludu
credits.overview: Chaitanya and Anu are neighbours who fall for each other. However their path towards marriage is far from easy. A haughty would-be mother-in-law complicates the proceedings. The couple put up a united front to clear their roadblocks.

credits.title: Mahanati
credits.overview: Mahanati depicts the life and career of one of Telugu cinema's greatest and most iconic starlets, the first Indian female super star, Savitri.

credits.title: Yuddham Sharanam
credits.overview: When his family is torn apart, Arjun sets out to on a journey to solve the mystery and seek revenge.

credits.title: Rarandoi Veduka Chudham
credits.overview: A happy-go-lucky boy falls in love with a village belle and after initially facing rejection from her, realises that he has a lot to do to win her love.

credits.title: Saahasam Swaasaga Saagipo
credits.overview: A couple on a road trip across the country are thrown into a situation that is beyond their control.

credits.title: Premam
credits.overview: Vikram falls in love with three women at different stages of his life which changes him as a person until he finally meets the love of his life.

credits.title: Dohchay
credits.overview: A conman faces his biggest threat when he is in urgent need for a lump sum and a policeman is after him to catch him red handed.

credits.title: Oka Laila Kosam
credits.overview: A carefree young man leading an aimless life falls in love with a cultured and simple woman, but she does not reciprocate his emotion. However, when circumstances force her to marry him, he embarks upon a journey to make his wife fall in love with him. Will he succeed in his mission?

credits.title: Manam
credits.overview: A married couple die in an accident, leaving behind a son. As he grows up and becomes successful, he comes across reincarnations of his father and mother as youngsters, and vows to bring them back together.

credits.title: Autonagar Surya
credits.overview: Surya, a juvenile offender, completes his education in prison and upon release embarks on his dream project. However, he has to overcome numerous obstacles to turn his dream into a reality.

credits.title: Tadakha
credits.overview: A gentle and introverted young man is given employment in the police department, when his father, an inspector, dies of a sudden heart attack. In the line of duty, when he earns the wrath of a dangerous gangster, he and his brother must fight to defeat their powerful enemy. Will they succeed in doing so?

credits.title: Bejawada
credits.overview: A fearless young man sets out to avenge his brother's death by eliminating the devious criminals responsible for the murder. In the process, he must also fight for justice and save the labourers' and students' unions from the gangster's ruthless tyranny. Will he succeed in his mission?

credits.title: Dhada
credits.overview: A carefree man inadvertently frees a group of kidnapped young women from a criminal gang of traffickers and earns their wrath. His girlfriend's wealthy father arranges her wedding with an equally wealthy, but psychotic man. Will the man succeed in defeating his enemies and protect his girlfriend?

credits.title: 100% Love
credits.overview: Balu and Mahalakshmi are both very competitive in college, which leads to ego clashes. When they meet again after a few years, they try to outdo each other until they realize that they are in love.

credits.title: Vinnaithaandi Varuvaayaa
credits.overview: A young, aspiring filmmaker falls in love with a girl who moves into the house above his, but her sophisticated nature does more harm than good to him.

credits.title: Ye Maaya Chesave
credits.overview: An aspiring Hindu director falls in love with a Christian girl whose parents disapprove of their impending relationship.

credits.title: Josh
credits.overview: When a man in search of employment, becomes involved with a group of students, who are being led astray by destructive influences, he invests all his energy and effort into ensuring that the students are able to stave off the negative powers. Why is he so passionate about helping the students?
